description: Search Dataplex healthcare datasets by keyword (e.g. 'Medicare physician spending', 'nursing home compliance', 'prior authorization CMS-0057', 'FDA adverse events', 'NPI provider', 'CDC drug overdose deaths'). Matches product names and descriptions, 300+ CMS feed titles, 1,500+ CDC dataset names, and column names; returns matching products with the specific feeds, datasets and columns that matched.
name: search_health_datasets
